# has gender identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGenderIdentity`](gmeow-hasGenderIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGenderIdentity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)

Relates a person to a self-asserted gender-identity facet they hold. Non-functional and contextual — a person bears many co-equal identities; a superseded one is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. MUST NOT be inferred from [`gmeow:hasPronounSet`](gmeow-hasPronounSet.md), [`gmeow:honorific`](gmeow-honorific.md), [`gmeow:hasGenderExpression`](gmeow-hasGenderExpression.md) or [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md).
